typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		groupCK as string,
		classID as string,
		planID as string,
		productID as string,
		planEntryDate as timestamp,
		effectiveDate as timestamp,
		termDate as timestamp,
		eligibilityCreateDate as timestamp,
		memberCK as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT distinct ml.memberKey as memberCK 	,COALESCE(t2.AGP_GROUP_KEY,me.groupCK) as groupCK 	,me.classID 		,CASE WHEN me.groupCK = 104 and me.classID = \'HIP0\'  		  THEN substring(\'IN \' + me.planID,1,10) ELSE me.planID END AS planID 	,me.productID 	,me.planEntryDate 	,me.effectiveDate 	,me.termDate 	,me.eligibilityCreateDate FROM ##PDS_WGS_GROUP_KEYS t inner join [APP_RTDI].[DI_Stage_MemberEligibility] me with (nolock) on t.AGP_GROUP_KEY = me.groupCK or t.OLD_GROUP_KEY = me.groupCK left outer join ##PDS_WGS_GROUP_KEYS t2 on me.groupCK = t2.OLD_GROUP_KEY inner join (select memberCK, COALESCE(t3.AGP_GROUP_KEY,m2.groupCK) AS groupCK, classID, planID, productID, MAX(publicationDTM) maxPubDate 	 from [APP_RTDI].[DI_Stage_MemberEligibility] m2 with (nolock) 	 left outer join ##PDS_WGS_GROUP_KEYS t3 on m2.groupCK = t3.OLD_GROUP_KEY 	group by memberCK, COALESCE(t3.AGP_GROUP_KEY,m2.groupCK), classID, planID, productID) mmax 	on me.memberCK = mmax.memberCK 	and COALESCE(t2.AGP_GROUP_KEY,me.groupCK) = mmax.groupCK 	and me.classID = mmax.classID 	and me.planID = mmax.planID 	and me.productID = mmax.productID 	and me.publicationDTM = mmax.maxPubDate inner join APP_RTDI.DI_Consolidated_MemberList ml with (nolock) 	on me.memberCK = convert(varchar(50),ml.externalId) WHERE me.publicationDTM > ?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> CareAdvanceCMDMMemberEligibility
CareAdvanceCMDMMemberEligibility derive(groupCK = groupCK) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount1
PlaceHolderRowCount1 sink(input(
		PlanEntryDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PlanID as string,
		MemberNumber as string,
		GroupKey as string,
		ClassID as string,
		ProductID as string,
		TermDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SourceUpdateDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		EffectiveDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		PlanEntryDate = planEntryDate,
		PlanID = planID,
		MemberNumber = memberCK,
		GroupKey = groupCK,
		ClassID = classID,
		ProductID = productID,
		TermDate = termDate,
		SourceUpdateDate = eligibilityCreateDate,
		EffectiveDate = effectiveDate)) ~> PDSCACMDMMemberEligibilityStaging
